since.title: FX delay TIME adds dotted quarter
since.text: FX delay TIME adds dotted quarter (4D), dotted eighth (8D) and dotted sixteenth (16D), plus upstream 4T/32T triplets; original TIME IDs 0–9 keep their timing and storage values. Short LCD labels prevent 16D from being mistaken for 1/16.

since.title: Delay-time display order follows note duration;
since.text: Delay-time display order follows note duration; the existing 65,536-sample buffer continues limiting intervals to approximately 1.49 seconds, with no storage-layout change.

since.title: Change new/initialized projects' delay TIME default
since.text: Change new/initialized projects' delay TIME default from regular 1/8 (stored ID 1) to dotted eighth 8D (stored ID 12). Explicit TIME selections in previously saved projects load unchanged.

since.title: Make PROJECT LOAD/SAVE and TOOLS clear/init
since.text: Make PROJECT LOAD/SAVE and TOOLS clear/init GO confirmations usable: approximately three seconds to turn the same knob again, with AGAIN message visible for the full confirmation window. Untouched project data and unchanged action semantics.

since.title: Remove the misleading non-adjustable SYSTEM USB
since.text: Remove the misleading non-adjustable SYSTEM USB display and shift the remaining controls left: K1 SYNC, K2 ROUT, K3 CPU, K4 unused. This changes only page layout/encoder mapping; USB interfaces and stored parameter IDs are unchanged.

since.title: Browser simulation hides absolute-position tick marks
since.text: Browser simulation hides absolute-position tick marks on endless encoders (main panel and FX feature labs) while retaining the MASTER volume pointer.

since.title: Set the firmware ORANGE LCD palette
since.text: Set the firmware ORANGE LCD palette to neon orange #FF4D00 (ID 0 background, #120804 ink) and ORANGE INV to #FF4D00 ink on #100604 background (ID 1), replacing the earlier #FF6500 autumn-orange candidate. The other twelve themes, saved IDs and website colors remain unchanged.

since.title: Add DLY MODE NORM/PING (second FX
since.text: Add DLY MODE NORM/PING (second FX delay page): alternating stereo echoes reuse the existing delay ring. Old FDRF projects load as NORM; the mode uses reserved byte rsv[0], without changing the record length.

since.title: Append LFO DEST 20..23 = DST/CHO/DLY/REV.
since.text: Append LFO DEST 20..23 = DST/CHO/DLY/REV. The Nauclerus ACID MORPH destination remains ID 19; every preexisting route retains its identity.

since.title: Add eight-track SOLO on the GLO/MUTE
since.text: Add eight-track SOLO on the GLO/MUTE screen's black keys, with F#5 switching momentary/toggle. Existing white-key mute commands remain.

since.title: Enable SYSTEM SYNC OFF/USB, ROUT NOTE/SEL/TRACK,
since.text: Enable SYSTEM SYNC OFF/USB, ROUT NOTE/SEL/TRACK, and GLOBAL THRU OFF/ON. USB clock and TRS-to-USB channel forwarding use the existing USB MIDI output; TRS remains input only. THRU is saved in previously unused settings bit 14.
